original_ai_output.title_zh: 观点：阿卜耶伊冲突的新动态
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 一篇观点文章回顾了2005年《全面和平协议》以来阿卜耶伊地区的冲突演变，包括阿卜耶伊议定书、边界委员会争议及2009年常设仲裁法院裁决。文章指出阿卜耶伊公投始终未能举行，最终地位仍未解决，并认为边界争议还引发了与邻近社区的新纠纷。

key_facts.fact: 2005年签署的《全面和平协议》旨在结束苏丹长期内战，并为南苏丹、阿卜耶伊等地区设立单独机制
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Comprehensive Peace Agreement (CPA), signed in 2005, was brokered to end Sudan’s long-running civil war. The agreement established separate mechanisms for addressing the conflicts in Southern Sudan, Abyei, Southern Kordofan and Blue Nile.

key_facts.fact: 2011年1月南苏丹举行独立公投，98.83%选民选择分离，南苏丹于2011年7月9日独立
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: In January 2011, South Sudan held its independence referendum, with 98.83% of voters choosing secession. South Sudan became independent on 9 July 2011.

key_facts.fact: 阿卜耶伊公投未能举行，阿卜耶伊公投委员会从未成立，该地区最终地位仍未解决
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Abyei referendum, however, was not held. The Abyei Referendum Commission was never established, leaving the territory’s final status unresolved.

key_facts.fact: 2009年7月常设仲裁法院作出最终裁决，缩减了阿卜耶伊边界委员会主张的区域并确立修订边界
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: In July 2009, an arbitral tribunal constituted under the Permanent Court of Arbitration issued its final award on the delimitation of Abyei.
